result: In a solvable wide model, learning rates between 2/λ₀ and 4/λ₀ make the loss spike while the kernel (curvature) drops below 2/η: a catapult into a flatter minimum after ~log n steps. Real ReLU networks show the same lower edge, with the upper edge near 12/λ₀.
result_plain: Large learning rates catapult: loss spikes, curvature drops below 2/η, training converges flatter.
